title: Azahar 2125.0.1: official stable release
summary: Azahar published 2125.0.1 on March 26, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2125.0.1 on March 26, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Azahar is now available as libretro/RetroArch cores for various OS platforms. @warmenhoven 1215 + other PRs. Below is a list of platforms with available cores in this initial release. [x] Linux (x86 64). [x] Windows (x86 64).
